svg.script: function hghl(el) { for ( var i in el ){ var elem = document.getElementById(el[i]); if ( elem != null ) elem.setAttribute('class','highlight'); } } function uhghl(el) { for ( var i in el ){ var elem = document.getElementById(el[i]); if ( elem != null ) elem.setAttribute('class','unhighlight'); } }

g.title: Table AC2026.BOM_COMPONENT_REVISIONS ⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯ Engineering change revisions per component.
🔍 IX_BOM_REVISIONS_COMP ( COMPONENT_ID ) 🔍 Unq UK_BOM_REVISIONS ( COMPONENT_ID, REVISION_CODE )
⧉ SPECIFICATIONS json ⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯ JSON: spec delta captured with this revision.
Table AC2026.BOM_COMPONENT_VARIANTS ⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯ Region / market variants of a component (~15k rows).
🔍 IX_BOM_VARIANTS_COMP ( COMPONENT_ID ) 🔍 Unq UK_BOM_VARIANTS ( COMPONENT_ID, VARIANT_CODE )
⧉ VARIANT_ATTRIBUTES json ⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯ JSON: differentiating attributes for this variant.
Table AC2026.BOM_COMPONENTS ⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯ Master automotive component catalog (~7k rows). Specs and compliance stored as JSON.

⧉ COMPONENT_ID * number default "AC2026"."ISEQ$$_248268".nextval ↙ BOM_HEADERS( TOP_COMPONENT_ID ) ↙ BOM_ITEMS( COMPONENT_ID ) ↙ BOM_COMPONENT_REVISIONS( COMPONENT_ID ) ↙ BOM_COMPONENT_VARIANTS( COMPONENT_ID )

🔗 Referred by BOM_HEADERS ( TOP_COMPONENT_ID -> COMPONENT_ID ) Referred by BOM_ITEMS ( COMPONENT_ID ) Referred by BOM_COMPONENT_REVISIONS ( COMPONENT_ID ) Referred by BOM_COMPONENT_VARIANTS ( COMPONENT_ID )
⧉ SPECIFICATIONS json ⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯ JSON: engineering specifications (varies by category).
⧉ COMPLIANCE json ⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯ JSON: regulatory / homologation metadata (RoHS, REACH, ASIL, country of origin, ...).
Table AC2026.BOM_HEADERS ⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯ Vehicle Bill-of-Materials headers (~1k rows).
⧉ BOM_METADATA json ⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯ JSON: vehicle program metadata (markets, target volume, emissions target, ...).
Table AC2026.BOM_CATEGORIES ⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯ Component category lookup (engine, battery, chassis, ...).
Table AC2026.BOM_ITEMS ⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯ Hierarchical BOM line items, up to 7 levels deep.
⧉ ITEM_ATTRIBUTES json ⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯ JSON: BOM-line specific data (installation method, torque, criticality, ...).
